name: Twenty
summary: Twenty builds AI-enabled cyber-warfare systems for the U.S. military and intelligence community. It raised a $100M Series B at a $1B valuation in June 2026.
overview: Twenty builds AI-enabled, end-to-end cyber operations systems for the U.S. military and intelligence community. Its June 2026 Series B was intended to expand research, development, and deployment of its cyber-warfare capabilities.

intelligence.description: Twenty builds AI-enabled cyber-warfare systems for U.S. military and intelligence-community missions.
company: Twenty builds AI-enabled, end-to-end cyber operations systems for the U.S. military and intelligence community. The company describes its product as industrial-scale capability for modern cyber conflict.

In June 2026, Twenty announced a $100 million Series B led by Accel at a $1 billion valuation. It said the funding brought total capital raised to $138 million and would support research, development, and deployment.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Twenty reflects investor demand for cyber capabilities tied to national security. Contract conversion and responsible operational use will be more important than its early valuation headline.

changed.text: Twenty announces a $100M Series B led by Accel at a $1B valuation.

takeaways: Twenty is a cyber-warfare company, not a conventional enterprise-software provider.
Axios reported its $100M Series B at a $1B valuation.
Procurement and contract execution are the central evidence to watch.
